summary.name: Voxel Art
summary.visualIdentity: Voxel Art (Digital and 3D Aesthetics, explicit) builds figures and spaces from cubes of consistent voxel size. Stepped contours, controlled light, and color blocks establish depth. Motion animates complete forms or purposeful block assembly while keeping scale. Pixel textures on arbitrary meshes are not voxel geometry, and voxel art is distinct from pixel art.
summary.suitableUses: The source explicitly suits block-built characters and worlds. Inferred suitability includes world tours and explainers. Unit-based data suits it only in a hybrid, where each voxel honestly stands for a stated quantity. Target audiences are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Voxel size must stay consistent; rounded or scaled voxels misrepresent data. Pixel textures on non-voxel meshes are excluded. Strict isometric diagrams need an orthographic camera, since perspective shrinkage breaks equal sizes. Free camera spin should be avoided. Invented data is not permitted.
summary.palette: Suggested only, not canonical: background #EEE9DB, foreground #30444C, accent_1 #63928D, accent_2 #C0845D, using limited voxel blocks with warm and cool planes. Foreground on background measures 8.418:1 for text. Accents reach only 2.93 and 3.257 against foreground, so they are decorative fills. Gradients are disabled. Task colors override these.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicitly, motion animates complete forms or purposeful block assembly while maintaining scale. Assembly transforms are computed from time, and block color and visibility are tracked. Video state derives from seekable composition time. Interactive delivery may use 90-degree steps with a reduced-motion still. Camera dolly and orbit patterns list this style as a good fit but require real 3D depth.
summary.audio: Audio direction is unspecified for this style; no genre, tempo, voice, or mandatory layer is assigned. Choices should be inferred from topic, audience, and motion cadence. Explicit user audio requests and supplied assets take priority. Speech intelligibility, balance, clipping, and picture sync must be verified in the final video.
summary.assetRequirements: Cube instances of consistent dimensions, with per-block color and visibility data. Supplied exact colors and source artwork must be preserved. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Orbit or dolly motion needs complete 3D geometry or sufficient captured turntable views. Stateful simulations should be cached before rendering.
summary.combinations: Hybrid style-077 adds an orthographic isometric camera and 2D labels for system overviews and world tours, keeping voxel sizes and parallel edges consistent. Hybrid style-097 adds unit counts for volume comparisons, with one voxel equal to one stated unit, teal and terracotta categories, and scales starting at zero. Compatible motion patterns are camera dolly (motion-019) and orbit (motion-021).
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer is Three.js with InstancedMesh for cube geometry. Motion engine is a paused GSAP timeline, with one owner per animated property. Pipeline is HyperFrames by default; Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. Verify key frames, decoded video, and audio sync. Mark simulated appearance as distinct from photographed production.
